gap: No result ChatGPT got states how many 8-hour workdays each board runs per charge: on the makers' own hour ratings that is about 69 for the Keychron K3 Ultra 8K against 9 for the K3 Max (7.5 times the hours for $26.50 more), and 7.5 to 12.5 backlit workdays for the NuPhy Air75 V3 against about 2 for the Lofree Flow 2 84.
standout_why: Compared against mkbguide.com (cited in chat 2), keeb-finder's Air75 V2 / K3 Max / Air75 V3 compare (cited in chat 2) and the RTINGS low-profile list (cited in both). mkbguide already prints the raw maker hour claims for the Air75 V3, K3 Ultra 8K, Flow 2 84 and Flow Lite84, so the inputs are on a cited page. It gives no K3 Max hours, no per-workday figure, no implied current draw and no like-for-like comparison. keeb-finder lists only mAh, weight and price. The RTINGS page returned only navigation to my fetch, so its body is not compared. Wirecutter could not be opened. The new part is the division and the K3 Ultra vs K3 Max gap. All of it rests on maker ratings taken under different conditions, not measurements.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. The Air75 V3 has the longest rated runtime under $150, lit or unlit. Among the Keychrons, the K3 Ultra 8K is the battery pick: 7.5 times the K3 Max's rated hours for $26.50 more at today's store prices, which undercuts ChatGPT's 'best value' label for the K3 Max for anyone working wirelessly. Our Lofree rows do not win on battery: the Flow Lite 2 84 comes to 12.5 rated workdays and the Flow 2 84 to about 2 backlit workdays, so they have to win on another segment (price through our link, typing feel).
